c1-14-01.title: Communicative Challenge: A Road Through the Marsh
c1-14-01.scenario: Károly asks what happens to the animals of a marsh when a road cuts through it.
c1-14-01.prompt: Tell Károly what the road does and what follows, in one sentence.
cues: Say what the road does to the habitat
Say what that does to the animals
c1-14-01.target: Az út átmegy az erdőn, nagy kárt okozva az állatoknak.
c1-14-01.english: The road goes through the forest, causing great harm to the animals.
c1-14-01.canDo: I can link a cause and its result with a participle (*kárt okozva, vizet visszatartva*).

c1-14-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Too Much Sun
c1-14-02.scenario: Károly asks what happens to the power grid if there is a lot of solar energy.
c1-14-02.prompt: Tell Károly what becomes more important, with a condition.
c1-14-02.target: Amennyiben sok a napenergia, úgy a tárolók még fontosabbak lesznek.
c1-14-02.english: If there is a lot of solar energy, storage units will be even more important.
c1-14-02.canDo: I can state a condition about the power grid with *amennyiben …, úgy …*.

c1-14-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Company That Says It Is Green
cues: Say what the company says about itself
Say what it does not do
c1-14-03.target: Egyes nagyvállalatok kötelesek fenntarthatósági jelentést készíteni.
c1-14-03.english: Some large companies are obliged to prepare a sustainability report.
c1-14-03.canDo: I can say that a company is obliged to do something (*kötelesek fenntarthatósági jelentést készíteni*).

c1-14-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Checks the Power Plant
c1-14-04.scenario: Károly asks who examines the lifetime extension of a nuclear power plant.
c1-14-04.prompt: Tell Károly which authority does it.
cues: Name the thing that is examined
c1-14-04.target: Az üzemidő-hosszabbítást az Országos Atomenergia Hivatal vizsgálja meg.
c1-14-04.english: The lifetime extension is examined by the Hungarian Atomic Energy Authority.
c1-14-04.canDo: I can say which authority examines a nuclear power plant's lifetime extension.

c1-14-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Man and Nature in the Text
c1-14-05.scenario: You have read the text about Fekete István. Károly asks what it says about people and nature.
c1-14-05.prompt: Tell Károly what the text says.
c1-14-05.target: A körforgásos gazdaság újra használja az anyagokat, mint a természet.
c1-14-05.english: The circular economy reuses materials, as nature does.
c1-14-05.canDo: I can explain the circular economy in a few sentences.

c1-14-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: What I Learned
c1-14-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks what you have learned about energy and nature in this unit.
c1-14-consolidation.prompt: Say something about the circular economy and about solar power.
cues: Say what the circular economy does with materials
c1-14-consolidation.target: A körforgásos gazdaság újra használja az anyagokat, a napenergiához pedig tárolók kellenek.
c1-14-consolidation.english: The circular economy uses materials again, and solar energy needs storage.
c1-14-consolidation.canDo: I can link a cause and its result with a participle and state a condition about the grid.
